summary: Brazil's final preparations and tactical blueprint for their World Cup 2026 campaign, including squad status and key matchups ahead.

items.headline: Brazil's Elite Squad
items.body: Brazil brings a mix of experienced campaigners and rising talents to the tournament. Led by forward Neymar and midfielder Vinícius Júnior, the squad combines attacking flair with defensive solidity.

items.headline: Fitness Report
items.body: All key players confirmed fit for the tournament. No major injury concerns reported in the latest medical assessments.
